from itertools import product

before_bits = []
after_bits = []

for x in product((0, 1), repeat=10):
    # Symbols below come from the decoded affine/ReLU gate identities:
    # R = x6 & x7 & x1 & x9
    # P = XNOR(x6,x7) XOR XOR(x7,x9)
    # Q = XOR(x0,x4) AND NAND(x3,x8)
    r = x[6] and x[7] and x[1] and x[9]
    p = (x[6] == x[7]) ^ (x[7] ^ x[9])
    q = (x[0] ^ x[4]) and not (x[3] and x[8])
    s = p and not q

    before_bits.append("1" if (r or (not x[6] and s)) else "0")
    after_bits.append("1" if r else "0")

sub = {
    "before_outputs": "".join(before_bits),
    "after_outputs": "".join(after_bits),
}
